articles.description: Florida's Everglades are the testing ground for a groundbreaking approach in wildlife management: robotic rabbits that simulate real marsh rabbits through movement and scent. By attracting the invasive Burmese pythons, these high-tech decoys are monitored via cameras to facilitate their removal. This pioneering strategy seeks to overcome the difficulties of detecting these sly snakes while protecting native wildlife from decline.
